developer_prompt: Align the Next.js project (TypeScript, App Router) with the **3-hour hackathon demo** track. Production dependencies only: `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `@supabase/supabase-js`, `@anthropic-ai/sdk`. Do **not** add `@e2b/sdk`/`e2b`, `@slack/bolt`, `@octokit/rest`, or `openai`. Keep `tsconfig.json` strict (`strict: true`) and exclude `venv` if present. `.env.example` must list: `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, and optionally `SENTRY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (for a later mock-verified ingest route).
success_criteria: `npm run dev` starts. `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. `.env.example` contains the listed keys. `package.json` dependencies match the demo stack (no Slack/E2B/GitHub/OpenAI SDK).

developer_prompt: Add SQL for `incidents` and `execution_logs` (minimal columns needed for demo: incident id, status, sentry/payload summary, timestamps; logs with incident_id, message, kind). Export a typed Supabase client and functions: insert incident, update incident status, append execution log. Skip `fix_attempts` unless needed for one screen. Apply schema in the Supabase dashboard (user already has a project).
success_criteria: Mutations compile with strict types. Insert/update/log functions exist and match the slim schema.

developer_prompt: POST `/api/sentry`: parse a JSON body defensively (nested fields optional). Extract any available Sentry/issue id and stack/context text. Insert a new incident with status `investigating` via Supabase. **Mock** webhook signature verification (no crypto dependency). Return JSON `{ incident_id }` with 200 on success.
success_criteria: curl/Postman with a sample payload returns 200 and a UUID; row appears in Supabase.

developer_prompt: Implement a **fake** sandbox module: `startSandbox(repoUrl: string)` returns a handle object; `runShellCommand`, `readFiles`, `writeFile` append **canned** log lines (e.g. clone, npm install, npm test fail then pass) to `execution_logs` via Supabase or return strings for the worker to log. No cloud sandbox SDK—pure TypeScript suitable for a live demo if APIs fail.
success_criteria: Worker can call the module without network sandbox; logs read like a real terminal for the judges.

developer_prompt: Use `@anthropic-ai/sdk` only. `runFixLoop(incident, sandbox)` sends the stack trace + context; register **at most three** tools (`read_files`, `run_shell_command`, `write_file`) mapped to the mock sandbox. Cap iterations at **3**. Prefer a short system prompt: staff engineer fixing a TS bug with tests. On API errors, fall back to a **static** suggested patch text so the demo still runs.
success_criteria: One code path calls Anthropic with tools; tool results feed back into the loop; loop stops at 3 rounds or completion; no OpenAI import.

developer_prompt: Export `auditDiff(diff: string): { approved: boolean; reason: string }` using **heuristics** only: reject if diff is empty, if suspiciously large deletions, or if it adds obvious red flags (e.g. many `any` typings). No `openai` package. This replaces GPT-based audit for the hackathon window.
success_criteria: Pure functions, strict return type, fast and offline; suitable to swap for an LLM later.

developer_prompt: Add minimal POST routes (or one route with `action` query) that: **Approve** sets incident status (e.g. `resolved` or `ready`) and stores a **display diff** from prior step if passed in body; **Retry** sets status back to `investigating` or `queued`. No Slack signing, no Octokit. Return JSON success/error.
success_criteria: Dashboard buttons can drive status changes without external services.

developer_prompt: POST with `{ incident_id }`: sequence—set status `reproducing`, call mock sandbox logging, run brain loop, run heuristic auditor, persist proposed diff text on the incident or in logs, set status `awaiting_approval`. Try/catch with errors logged to `execution_logs`. **Do not** call Slack, E2B SDK, or GitHub.
success_criteria: One demo flow from incident id to awaiting_approval with logs visible in DB.

developer_prompt: Build a simple **Engine Room** page: left panel shows `execution_logs` as a terminal (use **polling** every 1–2s or Supabase Realtime if already wired—polling is OK). Right panel: status stepper from incident status. Add **Approve** / **Retry** buttons calling the demo API routes. Show proposed diff in a `<pre>` or monospace block—**no** PR URL required. Tailwind for styling.
success_criteria: Judges see logs update and can approve/retry from the browser; no Slack or GitHub account needed for the demo.
